# Miscellaneous › Combat Action

> Use this oracle to help inspire an action for a foe in a fight. When you’re not sure what an enemy does next, particularly when they have you in a bad spot, roll on this table and interpret the result as appropriate to the nature of the enemy and battleground.
>
> Datasworn `oracle_rollable:sundered_isles/misc/combat_action` · 1d100

- [3] Back away or stand off
- [3] Block a path or cut off an objective
- [3] Change weapons or tactics
- [3] Charge recklessly
- [3] Compel a surrender or concession
- [3] Corner, trap, or entangle
- [3] Destroy something or render it useless
- [3] Force off balance or out of position
- [3] Hide or take cover
- [3] Intimidate, taunt, or frighten
- [3] Leverage the advantage of a weapon or ability
- [3] Leverage the terrain or environment
- [3] Lure into a vulnerable position
- [3] Make a cautious or probing attack
- [3] Make a ferocious or reckless attack
- [3] Make a precise or careful attack
- [3] Make a showy move intended to impress
- [3] Maneuver to a better position
- [3] Move in close or grapple
- [3] Perform a feint or trick
- [3] Prepare or bolster a defense
- [3] Press an advantage
- [3] Provoke a careless response
- [3] Ready a decisive strike
- [3] Recover or repair

- [3] Seize a weapon or resource
